Run 2: 他很聪明的人：他是一个很聪明的人，An adjective needs to modify the noun inside a noun phrase here; use the copula before the noun phrase to say that he is an intelligent person. [rule: adjective_predicate]
Run 3: 他很聪明的人：他是一个很聪明的人，The phrase needs a predicate: add 是一个 before the noun phrase, while 很聪明 modifies 人. [rule: adjective_predicate]

output.reason: All runs address the malformed predicate/noun-phrase structure, and each correction yields a grammatical way to express that he is intelligent.
